title: Me: a helicopter. Them: the couch.
caption: Sag booked a helicopter, a string quartet and every firework in stock. Cancer wanted the couch, fuzzy socks and a real talk. Grand gestures are sweet. Being fully present is sweeter. Send this to the one who plans a mission when you just want a hug.
